findings.description: SYS-SUP-049 unconditionally requires a flow-fault report when code 4 is detected. CON-SUP-121 and SYS-SUP-023 remove the obligation to report the fault being handled if a watchdog reset occurs before the report and safe-state entry have completed.
findings.requested_change: Make the flow-fault reporting obligation consistent with the watchdog-reset exception in CON-SUP-121 and SYS-SUP-023.

findings.description: The entity is the first task whose checkpoint is missing or out of order, but neither SYS-SUP-049 nor CON-SUP-122 defines which checkpoint is out of order when received checkpoints are swapped. For expected order A, B and received order B, A, different interpretations can select A or B.
findings.requested_change: Define how to identify the out-of-order checkpoint for ambiguous sequences, using an approved product decision.
